gizmo.title: Masewera a ulendo wa malingaliro
gizmo.description: Dziko lotseguka loyendayenda. Malingaliro amakupezani ndi kukufunsani funso. Yankhani molondola kuti mugonjetse limodzi ndi kutsegula nyumba yake. Chidule chimasonyeza zoyesa ndi zoyenera kubwereza.

configure.title: Ulendo
configure.description: Malangizo owonetsedwa pa sikirini yoyambira. Uzani wosewera cholinga cha ulendowu.

configure.title: Malingaliro
configure.description: Lingaliro lililonse ndi nyumba yokhala ndi chilombo.

configure.title: Masewera atatha
configure.description: Si lofunika. Limalowa m'malo mwa bokosi lokopera malangizo pa gawo lomaliza ndi zomwe mwalemba, monga sitepe yotsatira kapena ulalo.

configure.title: Mabatani owonjezera masewera atatha
configure.description: Si ofunika. Mabatani kapena maulalo owonetsedwa pafupi ndi Sewerani kachiwiri pa gawo lomaliza.

advanced.title: Mbewu ya munthu
advanced.description: Mawu aliwonse. Mbewu yomweyo imapanga munthu yemweyo nthawi zonse. Iyi ndi mbewu yomwe avatar ya HAX imagwiritsa ntchito.

advanced.title: Gwiritsani ntchito munthu wa amene walowa
advanced.description: Wina akalowa mu HAX, munthuyo amawoneka ngati avatar yake. Ena onse amaona mbewu ya pamwambapa.

advanced.title: Mzere pamwamba pa malangizo
advanced.description: Siyani opanda kanthu kuti mugwiritse mzere wokhazikika.

advanced.title: Malangizo oti mukopere
advanced.description: Amawonetsedwa pa gawo lomaliza ndi batani lokopera. Chotsani kuti mubise bokosilo.

advanced.title: Dzina la masewera
advanced.description: Limatchula masewerawa mu zochitika za kupita patsogolo ndi chizindikiro cha OER Schema.

advanced.title: ID ya masewera
advanced.description: Si lofunika. Limasiyanitsa masewerawa ndi ena patsamba mu zochitika za kupita patsogolo.
